title: Remove legacy Python settings from VS Code workspace configuration

subtasks.content: Remove the `// Python settings` comment and all `python.*` keys (defaultInterpreterPath, analysis.typeCheckingMode, linting.enabled, linting.flake8Enabled, linting.mypyEnabled, formatting.provider, testing.pytestEnabled, testing.pytestArgs) from `.vscode/settings.json`
Remove the `ck3LanguageServer.pythonPath` key from `.vscode/settings.json` while preserving all other `ck3LanguageServer.*` keys
Remove Python artifact patterns (`**/__pycache__`, `**/*.pyc`, `**/.pytest_cache`) from `files.exclude` in `.vscode/settings.json`, keeping only `**/node_modules` and `**/dist`
Remove Python artifact patterns (`**/__pycache__`, `**/.pytest_cache`) from `search.exclude` in `.vscode/settings.json`, keeping only `**/node_modules` and `**/dist`
Remove `python-envs.defaultPackageManager` from the `settings` block in `pychivalry.code-workspace`; if `settings` becomes empty, remove the `settings` key entirely
Validate `.vscode/settings.json` parses as valid JSON (e.g., `python3 -m json.tool` or `json_pp`)
Verify no `python` or `pythonPath` keys remain in either file (grep confirmation)
Verify all active CK3 language server settings (`ck3LanguageServer.enable`, `logLevel`, `trace.server`, `logWatcher.*`), editor settings, and non-Python exclusions are preserved unchanged
